```{r}
#| label: load data set
heart_data <- read_csv("HDM2123.csv")
```

```{r}
#| label: view dataset

# View dataset
View(heart_data)

# First six rows
head(heart_data)

# Structure and variable types
str(heart_data)

# Summary statistics
summary(heart_data)

# Dimensions
dim(heart_data)

# Column names
names(heart_data)
```

```{r}
#| label: view missing data
# Count missing values by variable
colSums(is.na(heart_data))

# Calculate missingness percentages
missing_summary <- heart_data %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      everything(),
      ~ sum(is.na(.))
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "missing_count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    missing_percent = 
      (missing_count / nrow(heart_data)) * 100
  )

missing_summary
```

```{r}
#| label: change variable name
heart_data <- heart_data %>%
  rename(
    year = Year,
    state = LocationAbbr,
    location = LocationDesc,
    geographic_level = GeographicLevel,
    mortality_rate = Data_Value,
    rate_unit = Data_Value_Unit,
    rate_type = Data_Value_Type,
    sex = Stratification1,
    race_ethnicity = Stratification2,
    lattitude = Y_lat,
    longitude = X_lon
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: creating factors
heart_data <- heart_data %>%
  mutate(
    geographic_level = factor(
      geographic_level,
      levels = c("Nation", "State", "County")
    ),

    sex = factor(
      sex,
      levels = c("Overall", "Female", "Male")
    ),

    race_ethnicity = factor(
      race_ethnicity,
      levels = c(
        "Overall",
        "White",
        "Black",
        "Hispanic",
        "American Indian or Alaska Native",
        "Asian",
        "Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander",
        "More than one race"
      )
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: 3 separate datasets by geo level
# National data
national_data <- heart_data %>%
  filter(geographic_level == "Nation")

# State data
state_data <- heart_data %>%
  filter(geographic_level == "State")

# County data
county_data <- heart_data %>%
  filter(geographic_level == "County")
```

# Top mortality states vis.

```{r}

state_summary <- heart_data %>%
  filter(
    geographic_level == "State",
    sex == "Overall",
    race_ethnicity == "Overall"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mortality_rate = readr::parse_number(
      as.character(mortality_rate)
    )
  ) %>%
  drop_na(mortality_rate) %>%
  group_by(location) %>%
  summarise(
    mortality_rate = mean(mortality_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mortality_rate)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  mutate(
    location = factor(
      location,
      levels = rev(location)
    ),
    hover_text = paste0(
      "<b>", location, "</b>",
      "<br>Mortality rate: ",
      round(mortality_rate, 1),
      " per 100,000"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
interactive_graph <- ggplot(
  data = state_summary,
  mapping = aes(
    x = location,
    y = mortality_rate,
    fill = mortality_rate,
    text = hover_text
  )
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#F2B8C1",
    high = "#5C0A16"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 States with the Highest Cardiovascular Mortality Rates in 2022",
    subtitle = "Age-adjusted, spatially smoothed, 3-year average rate (2022)",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mortality rate per 100,000 population",
    fill = "Mortality Rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 16,
      color = "#5C0A16"
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray40"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "gray25"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

interactive_graph <- ggplotly(
  interactive_graph,
  tooltip = "text"
)

interactive_graph
```

# Cardiovascular mortality by race/ethnicity

```{r}
# Prepare data
race_summary <- heart_data %>%
  filter(sex == "Overall") %>%
  group_by(race_ethnicity) %>%
  summarise(
    mortality_rate = mean(mortality_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(mortality_rate) %>%
  mutate(
    race_ethnicity = factor(
      race_ethnicity,
      levels = race_ethnicity
    )
  )

# Interactive bar chart
race_plot <- ggplot(
  data = race_summary,
  mapping = aes(
    x = mortality_rate,
    y = race_ethnicity,
    fill = race_ethnicity,
    text = paste0(
      "<b>", race_ethnicity, "</b>",
      "<br>Mortality Rate: ",
      round(mortality_rate, 1),
      " per 100,000"
    )
  )
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "#FDEDEC",
      "#FADBD8",
      "#F1948A",
      "#EC7063",
      "#CD6155",
      "#C0392B",
      "#922B21",
      "#641E16"
      
      
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Cardiovascular Mortality by Race/Ethnicity in 2022",
    subtitle = "National mortality rates per 100,000 population",
    x = "Mortality Rate per 100,000 in 2022",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 16
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )

# Convert to interactive plot
interactive_race <- ggplotly(
  race_plot,
  tooltip = "text"
)

interactive_race
```

# county comparisons

```{r}

# Summarize mortality rates by location
location_summary <- heart_data %>%
  group_by(location) %>%
  summarise(
    mortality_rate = mean(mortality_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mortality_rate))

# Top 15 locations
top_15 <- location_summary %>%
  slice_max(
    order_by = mortality_rate,
    n = 15,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  arrange(mortality_rate) %>%
  mutate(location = factor(location, levels = location))

# Bottom 15 locations
bottom_15 <- location_summary %>%
  slice_min(
    order_by = mortality_rate,
    n = 15,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  arrange(mortality_rate) %>%
  mutate(location = factor(location, levels = location))
```

```{r}
top_plot <- ggplot(
  top_15,
  aes(
    x = mortality_rate,
    y = location,
    text = paste0(
      "<b>", location, "</b>",
      "<br>Mortality Rate: ",
      round(mortality_rate, 1),
      " per 100,000"
    )
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    fill = "#641E16",
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "15 Locations with Highest Mortality",
    x = "Mortality Rate per 100,000",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )

interactive_top <- ggplotly(
  top_plot,
  tooltip = "text"
)

interactive_top

```

```{r}
 bottom_plot <- ggplot(
  bottom_15,
  aes(
    x = mortality_rate,
    y = location,
    text = paste0(
      "<b>", location, "</b>",
      "<br>Mortality Rate: ",
      round(mortality_rate, 1),
      " per 100,000"
    )
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    fill = "#F1948A",
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "15 Locations with Lowest Mortality",
    x = "Mortality Rate per 100,000",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )

interactive_bottom <- ggplotly(
  bottom_plot,
  tooltip = "text"
)

interactive_bottom
```

```{r}
state_comparison <- subplot(
  interactive_top,
  interactive_bottom,
  nrows = 1,
  shareY = FALSE,
  titleX = TRUE,
  titleY = FALSE,
  margin = 0.08
) %>%
  layout(
    title = list(
      text = "Cardiovascular Mortality: Highest vs. Lowest Counties in 2022"
    ),
    showlegend = FALSE
  )

state_comparison
```

# mortality difference 
```{r}
highest_rate <- max(
  location_summary$mortality_rate,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

lowest_rate <- min(
  location_summary$mortality_rate,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

mortality_difference <- highest_rate - lowest_rate

print(mortality_difference)
```
